title: Detailed light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bulbGlass' cx='42%' cy='38%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFE86B'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F2B830'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glowHalo' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE86B' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE86B' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='filamentGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF6C8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB020'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='46' fill='url(#glowHalo)'/>

  <!-- glass bulb -->
  <path d='M50 8
           C29 8 17 23 17 41
           C17 53 24 60 29 68
           C33 74 35 78 35 83
           L65 83
           C65 78 67 74 71 68
           C76 60 83 53 83 41
           C83 23 71 8 50 8 Z'
        fill='url(#bulbGlass)'/>
  <!-- glass highlight -->
  <path d='M36 20 C28 26 25 35 26 44 C27 50 31 55 34 59 C30 51 29 44 31 36 C33 28 37 23 41 20 Z'
        fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- filament stems -->
  <path d='M43 83 L43 66 Q43 62 46 60' fill='none' stroke='#C97A2E' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 83 L57 66 Q57 62 54 60' fill='none' stroke='#C97A2E' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- filament coils -->
  <path d='M46 60 L49 50 L52 58 L55 50 L54 60'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#filamentGlow)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='2.2' fill='#FFFBE6' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='34' y='82' width='32' height='5' rx='2' fill='#B9C2CC'/>
  <rect x='34' y='87' width='32' height='4.5' rx='2' fill='#96A0AB'/>
  <rect x='34' y='91.5' width='32' height='4.5' rx='2' fill='#B9C2CC'/>
  <rect x='38' y='96' width='24' height='3.5' rx='1.7' fill='#7A8490'/>
  <!-- base shading lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='85' x2='65' y2='85' stroke='#DCE3EA' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='89.5' x2='65' y2='89.5' stroke='#DCE3EA' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- contact tip -->
  <path d='M45 99.5 Q50 96.5 55 99.5' fill='none' stroke='#5C6672' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
